dct_description_sm: Fewer than 15 studies in the recent past (2010-2019) have addressed the impacts of wildfire on permafrost in Canada, with most field investigations focusing on the rapid development of thermokarst at high ice-content sites. The purpose of this dataset is to provide field measurements of changes in frost table depths 1-5 years following fire at low ice-content sites (which are widespread in permafrost regions).
dct_title_s: Frost table depths from 1-5 years post-fire in the boreal forest, Northwest Territories, Canada.
